definition: Jeffrey Adgate Dean (born July 23, 1968) is an American computer scientist and software engineer.
details: Co-designed MapReduce, Bigtable, Spanner, DistBelief, TensorFlow, TPUs, and co-founded Google Brain. He is best known for his work at Google, which he joined in 1999. He led Google AI from 2018 to 2023 and was Google's chief scientist from 2023 to 2026. Dean co-founded the AI research start-up Discovery Loop in 2026.

explainer.lead: Jeff Dean is an American computer scientist and software engineer. His work spans distributed computing, information retrieval, machine learning and compiler.
explainer.knownFor: Notable works include Web search for a planet: the google cluster architecture and MapReduce: Simplified Data Processing on Large Clusters.

contributions.name: === Early career === Before graduate school, Dean worked at the World Health Organization's Global Programme on AIDS, developing software for statistical modeling and forecasting of the HIV/AIDS pandemic.
